content.title: Eni CEO, US delegation meet to bolster energy ties
content.summary: In a series of meetings on the sidelines of the Gastech conference in Milan, Descalzi hosted U.S. Secretary of Energy Chris Wright, Secretary of Interior Doug Burgum and Ambassador to Italy Tilman Fertitta, discussing energy security and Eni's expanding investments in the United States, Eni said in a statement.  The parties reiterated their mutual satisfaction with a deal signed by Eni and Venture Global in July, the Italian group's first long-term liquefied natural gas deal with a U.S. producer.
